basic_info.description: 999 Green stands high above the lights of San Francisco and offers the most extraordinary views the City has to offer. On the rarely available north west corner, with seemingly endless City and Bay views that feel like they are in the apartment. The living room, primary bedroom and guest bedroom all face north, with sliding glass doors leading to a balcony with jaw-dropping City and water views. Kitchen has been opened up to the living and dining area, allowing you to enjoy the views from every room in the apartment. 999 Green is one of the most elegant and sophisticated full service buildings in the City, with doorman, building handyman and professional onsite property manager. Atop Russian Hill but near all the dining, services and other amenities of upper Polk commercial corridor.
